claims: Rocky Carroll is leaving NCIS as a series regular after 18 seasons.
Director Leon Vance is killed off in NCIS's 500th episode (Season 23, 2026).
Rocky Carroll will remain with NCIS as a director, notes Variety.
Rocky Carroll has directed multiple episodes in previous seasons of NCIS, notes Variety.
The death of Director Vance was an intentional decision to "shake up" the 500th episode, notes Parade.
Rocky Carroll will return to the set shortly to direct future episodes of NCIS Season 23, as reported by Marca.
Rocky Carroll called it a "See you later" rather than a final goodbye, as reported by Marca.
Leon Vance joined NCIS in Season 5.
Leon Vance became the longest-running director in NCIS's history.
